Commercial temporary fencing

Emergency & Restoration Fencing

Temporary perimeters for commercial properties after storms, fires, vehicle damage, or an unexpected loss of access control. Tell Richard where the site is and what needs to be closed off.

Get a clear answer on timing

Call with the address, a description of the damage, and any access restrictions. Emergency scheduling depends on the location, current work, and equipment available. Richard will discuss what can be installed and when.

The usual installation window is 24–48 hours. Emergency work can move faster; confirm the actual arrival time on the call.

Choose fencing for the next stage

Panels and stands can establish a temporary boundary quickly and move as the restoration work develops. A post-driven line may suit a longer closure where the perimeter needs to remain in place.

Windscreen can reduce the view into the property while cleanup and restoration are underway. Let Richard know if adjusters, inspectors, or equipment need separate access.

Keep the restoration team moving

Plan gates around the vehicles that need to enter, including debris removal and equipment deliveries. A useful perimeter leaves the restoration crew access to the work.

We carry umbrella, general liability, commercial auto, and workers compensation insurance. Ask Richard about certificates required for your project.

Questions about this service

Do I need exact measurements before calling?

No. Start with the address and a description of the area. Approximate dimensions and access details help Richard plan the response.

Can the fence stay during a longer restoration?

Yes. Standard rentals cover up to 12 months for the agreed term. Discuss an extension before that term ends.

Do you repair the damaged permanent fence?

No. Fence Wizards provides temporary fence rental. Permanent fence repairs are outside our services.
